chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: I agree some text would make this clearer

chat.author: Mo Zanaty
chat.text: Cullen sees 2 confusing things: 1. Location filter relative vs absolute start, add subsections to clarify. 2. Fill-fetch parameter interaction with location filter for the common case of relative joining fetch, add text for that common case.

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: IMO it's a design flaw if a relay can't aggregate N downstream subscriptions into 1 upstream subscription

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: that's the premise behind why MoQ scales

chat.author: Victor Vasiliev
chat.text: Do we need to propagate filters though? @Luke

chat.author: Yu You
chat.text: we tested the OR operations for subgroup filterings in a single SUBSCIRIBE and it is very handy.

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: I don't want unnecessary and especially not duplicate backbone traffic

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: IDK I can't see how you can avoid ^ without OR

chat.author: Yu You
chat.text: a question, for REQUEST_UPDATE, would it overwrite all existing subscription by the new ones?

chat.author: Cullen Jennings
chat.text: Martin ... we need make for break before handover from wifi / cellular etc so I think there are many cases for multiple subcriptions but agree with your point on avoid over long span. And agree luke  that this was point of protocol

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: Cullen; I would hope people would use address migration when over HTTP/3, but otherwise agreed

chat.author: Victor Vasiliev
chat.text: I am not sure what multiple subscriptions on the same QUIC connection have to do with make before break

chat.author: Cullen Jennings
chat.text: +1 on need OR, don't care how spell / describe it

chat.author: Victor Vasiliev
chat.text: I personally think our current spelling is reasonable

chat.author: Mo Zanaty
chat.text: @Yu, yes, REQUEST_UPDATE replaces the entire filter parameter including all SetIDs and Property Types (for property filters).

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: As long as you ban REQUEST_UPDATE
